Mariana (CS): Hey team — onboarding issue for Tethys Corp. Their web SDK init shows intermittent 429s (about 8-12%) during ramp from CI. See sample logs.
Devon (Eng): Thx. Do we have token type? ephemeral vs project key?
Mariana (CS): Using ephemeral tokens minted by their backend; TTL 30s. They parallelize 40 clients in startup job.
Sam - SDK: 40 parallel with 30s TTL is a classic preflight stampede. Can you share raw request pattern? headers + sample curl
Mariana (CS): paste logs and curl
Mariana (CS): ```
POST /v1/sdk/init 200
200ms  "ok"
429  "rate_limited" x 1/10
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <ephemeral>" https://api.redwood.ai/sdk/init
```
Devon (Eng): Are they hitting preflight endpoint or generate-token separately? If preflight, our gateway treats ephemeral token preflight as heavier.
Mariana (CS): They do generate token then immediately call init from many workers.
Sam - SDK: Quick wins: 1) add client-side jitter/splay on token exchange (100-500ms) 2) reuse token across a small pool of workers 3) backoff+expo on 429s w/ randomized cap
Alex PSE: Also check that their CDN/proxy isn't reusing same connection dropping auth header; we saw header trimming causing re-auths.
Mariana (CS): Suggested code snippet I sent to them:
Sam - SDK: ```js
// splay token exchange
const jitter = () => Math.floor(Math.random()*300)+100;
await sleep(jitter());
// reuse token across pool
```
Devon (Eng): On our side, we can increase ephemeral token grace for this customer from 30s->90s as a temporary mitigation if they can't change code quickly. OpsBot will need a PR.
OpsBot: Ticket created CN-3482: ephemeral-ttl-request for Tethys Corp — assigned @devon
Mariana (CS): Customer implemented splay + token reuse, ran load tests — 429s fell to 0.4%. They're happy. Will keep monitoring for 24h.
Alex PSE: Nice. Suggest follow-up doc for onboarding best-practices (short checklist) — include preflight splay, token reuse, batch init.
Mariana (CS): I'll send onboarding checklist and log the playbook. :thumbsup: 
Devon (Eng): Marking as resolved in case notes.
